snippet.title: Bhangarh: The Untold Story - Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Official Cinematic Trailer for Bhangarh: The Untold Story, a first-person psychological adventure game developed by Golden Phoenix Studio. Players will explore the real-life-inspired location of Bhangarh Fort, said to be haunted by a curse in India. Embody a journalist who enters Bhangarh to explore the ancient remains, seek the truth behind forgotten history, and survive the horrors that awaken. Bhangarh: The Untold Story is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on PC (Steam).
